result.title: ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty
result.summary: Evaluating model uncertainty on real-world data is challenging because each instance provides only a single observed label, leaving true conditional class probabilities unknown. To address this, we introduce ProbabilityBench, a benchmark that provides exact, instance-level class probabilities across three simulated text-based domains: peer review, covert information transfer, and credit risk. By explicitly defining the full data-generating process for each environment, we analytically compute both exact class probabilities and Bayes error. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical guarantee that rendering these cases into natural-language memos strictly preserves their underlying generative probabilities. This exactness enables direct measurement of reported probability quality via KL divergence. Across 16 evaluated models, most models on the observed cost-quality Pareto frontiers are decision models, including Jev and Perplexity Decider. Finally, ProbabilityBench serves as a meta-evaluation framework, leveraging known ground-truth values to benchmark the accuracy of standard calibration metrics and Bayes-error estimators themselves.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ProbabilityBench，在同行评审、隐蔽信息传递、信用风险三个模拟文本域中提供精确的实例级类别概率与 Bayes 误差，并据此评测 16 个模型的概率报告质量以及常用校准指标、Bayes 误差估计器本身的准确性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「已知真值不确定性 + 校准度量元评估」的思路可能为 LVR 中基于置信度的停止决策（STOP）与推理预算分配提供评价线索，但材料完全基于文本与静态概率，未涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，可迁移性仍需核查。
